entity: National e-bike plus moped ER visits (NEISS code 3215), 2019-2023
what_we_add: The combined 3215 series 21,800 to 87,600 (4.0x), and the comparison that all injuries stayed flat (0.95x); sources report e-bikes alone (34,200 in 2023, near-10x from 2017)
why: CPSC, WRDW and USAFacts all report the same surge in the same NEISS data, same direction. Their 2023 number (34,200) is e-bikes only, ours folds in mopeds, so no contradiction; nobody states our combined figures or the flat-baseline comparison.
